messages:
Isaac: Quick pre-cutover check — planning to start staged rollout for SDK v22 Friday 2026-03-25 22:00 UTC. Who can own the deploy window?
Leila: I can run the host-side canary orchestration and watch infra metrics. Can we limit to EU first?
Sam: I’ll take canary bucket 1 (5%). I’ll run the smoke script and watch error rates. Slack ping if >1% 5m error spike.
Matt: Rollback plan: flip feature flag `sdk_v22_active=false` + revert gateway to `redwood/sdk-gateway:stable-21`. No DB migrations in this release.
Isaac: Good — no migrations confirmed. Config note: default behavior unchanged; we added optional `response_schema` param (ignored if not sent). Backwards compatible.
Anya: Client comms status? Need short note for support and a small migration blurb for integrations page.
Isaac: Migration guide and release notes published: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/v22/migration — includes code snippets and compatibility table.
Sam: Smoke checklist I’ll run (short): auth, streaming, kv-cache warm, perf sampling, 1k token regression. If any fail — rollback.
Leila: Canary cadence proposal: 5% -> 20% after 20m -> 100% after 30m if no issues. Autoscaling policy enabled for canaries.
Matt: Oncall handover: I’ll be online at start + 45m. If Sam needs immediate rollback, ping `@matt` and I’ll execute gateway revert.
Anya: Support playbook ready? Include `how to force-old-sdk` flag and expected timings.
Isaac: Support playbook snippet added to the release doc. Quick command for rollback one-liner: ```
kubectl set image deploy/sdk-gateway sdk-gateway=redwood/sdk-gateway:stable-21 -n production
```
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for release/v22-canary (build, unit, e2e). :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary schedule created: 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z buckets=[5,20,100] region=eu-west-1
Sam: Small ask — can we throttle client error logs to avoid noise during canary? Leila, can you set 5m rolling window?
Leila: Yep, will apply temporary log-sampling=0.1 for canary.
Isaac: Quick API note for SDKs: header `x-client-proto` added but optional. No client break. Call out in changelog.
Matt: I’ll prepare the revert runbook and attach to the incident template.
Anya: OK — owners: Sam (smoke), Leila (infra/canary), Matt (rollback/oncall), Isaac (docs). If no objections, start as scheduled.
Sam: +1
Leila: +1
Matt: +1
Isaac: Ready. I’ll send final channel reminder 30m before. :bell:
Anya: Thanks team — tagging support for visibility `@support` — publish comms at T-1hr.
Isaac: Final note: keep messages here for side-by-side timeline. If anything unexpected, escalate in #incidents.
